summary: This document defines two new RADIUS attributes that carry DHCP options, so a RADIUS server can pass DHCP-related configuration to the device that hands out addresses. It works for both DHCPv4 and DHCPv6 and for any service that relies on DHCP. It also updates RFC 4014 by relaxing a restriction on which RADIUS attributes may appear in the DHCP suboption.

eli5.summary: A front desk has a list of rules from the manager. This lets the manager slip extra notes, written in the hotel's own room-key language, onto that list for the desk to hand to guests.

questions: how does radius carry dhcp configuration
